faqs.q: How does SBM novio Credit Card\\\\\'s rewards program work?
faqs.a: You can earn Novio Coins as value-back on their spends. The card offers up to 10 Coins per Rs. 100 spent on fuel and 5 Coins per Rs. 100 spent on other categories, including UPI transactions. These Coins can be redeemed for brand vouchers through the Novio app.

faqs.q: What is the credit limit offered on SBM novio Credit Card?
faqs.a: The credit limit on SBM novio Credit Card is 90% of the fixed deposit amount. For example, if your FD is Rs. 10,000, your available credit limit will be Rs. 9,000.

faqs.q: Are there any fees associated with SBM novio Credit Card?
faqs.a: This card has no joining or annual fees. However, finance charges are 3.5% per month (42% p.a.), and late payment fee is Rs. 499. The card also has a low forex markup fee of 2.49%, making it suitable for international spends.

faqs.q: What is the eligibility criteria for this card?
faqs.a: The applicants must be Indian residents aged 18 years or above. The minimum FD required is Rs. 5,000 to apply for this credit card.

faqs.q: Can I use SBM novio Credit Card for international transactions?
faqs.a: Yes, SBM novio Credit Card charges a low forex markup fee of 2.49%, which is lower than many standard credit cards. This makes it a practical option for international spends.

faqs.q: Is SBM novio suitable for everyday spending?
faqs.a: Yes, the card offers rewards on everyday categories including UPI transactions and accelerated rewards on fuel spends, making it useful for day-to-day purchases while helping you build a strong credit profile.
